findings.current: Woojin did not know which one it was, but the flies were being fairly careful about it, sneaking in one at a time. If anything, that only heightened Jin Taekyung’s vigilance.
findings.defect: The draft makes the flies the agents exercising caution, while the source refers to the unidentified person controlling and sending them in one at a time.
findings.rationale: 어느 놈 refers to the unknown controller, whose attempt at caution paradoxically heightens Taekyung’s vigilance.
findings.replacement: Woojin did not know who was behind them, but whoever it was seemed to think they were being careful by sneaking the flies in one at a time. Instead, they were only putting Jin Taekyung further on guard.
findings.source: 어느 놈인지는 몰라도 나름 조심한다고 한 마리씩만 슬금슬금 들어오긴 하는데, 오히려 진태경의 경계심만 돋우는 꼴이다.

findings.current: All he could do to express his anger was wriggle around beneath the refrigerator.
findings.defect: The draft omits that Woojin is hiding in the gap beneath the refrigerator.
findings.rationale: 숨어 is a distinct physical action and reinforces that the tiny Familiar is concealed while venting its anger.
findings.replacement: The most he could do to express his anger was hide in the gap beneath the refrigerator and wriggle.
findings.source: 냉장고 밑 틈새에 숨어 꿈틀거리는 게 할 수 있는 최대의 분노 표출이었다.

findings.current: “As a C-rank Hunter, you may use the third floor.”
findings.defect: The draft says Taekyung may use the third floor specifically, rather than all floors through the third floor, obscuring the Store’s rank-based access hierarchy.
findings.rationale: 3층까지 establishes the third floor as his upper access limit, which the following comparison with his former second-floor limit depends on.
findings.replacement: “As a C-rank Hunter, you may access up to the third floor.”

findings.defect: The plural prematurely indicates multiple daggers, changing the quantity and weakening the deliberate ambiguity that sets up the storage-box reveal.
findings.rationale: 거요 is singular here; the clerk only realizes afterward that Taekyung is treating the entire adjacent storage box as one purchase unit.

findings.current: *These kinds of people have no professional courtesy, and they’re stupid on top of that.*
findings.defect: “These kinds of people” softens Woojin’s contemptuous 놈들이 and weakens his irritated internal voice.
findings.rationale: 놈들이 is openly derogatory in this profane internal complaint and should not be neutralized to “people.”
findings.replacement: *Bastards like that have no professional courtesy, and they’re stupid on top of it.*
findings.source: ‘꼭 저런 놈들이 상도덕도 없는 주제에 머리까지 나빠요.’

findings.current: “This brooch was made by overseas M Company. With its beautiful, tasteful design and built-in shield spell, it’s perfect for a lady’s self-defense…”
findings.defect: “A lady” loses the salesperson’s deferential reference to the customer’s wife and sounds unnatural in this sales pitch.
findings.rationale: 사모님 is a respectful way of referring to the male customer’s wife, not an unspecified lady.
findings.replacement: “This brooch was made by overseas M Company. With its beautiful, tasteful design and built-in shield spell, it’s perfect for your wife’s personal protection…”
findings.source: “해외 M사에서 제작한 브로치입니다. 아름답고 감각적인 디자인과 실드 마법이 내장되어 있어 사모님 호신용으로…….”

findings.current: His expression, as if he were about to die from the wasted money, was thoroughly irritating.
findings.defect: “Wasted money” adds the judgment that the purchase itself is wasteful, while the source describes his extreme reluctance to part with the money; “thoroughly irritating” also understates 밉상 그 자체.
findings.rationale: 돈 아까워 죽겠다는 describes visible pain at spending money, and 밉상 그 자체 characterizes him as the very picture of obnoxiousness.
findings.replacement: The look on his face, as if parting with the money were killing him, was utterly obnoxious.
findings.source: 돈 아까워 죽겠다는 얼굴이 밉상 그 자체다.

findings.current: But one of their own recognized one of their own.
findings.defect: The sentence is an awkward literal calque with unclear referents.
findings.rationale: 동류는 동류를 알아보는 법 means that those of the same kind recognize one another; the surrounding sentences identify that kind as mages.
findings.replacement: But mages recognized their own kind.

findings.current: *I can’t just keep taking it from this side, either.*
findings.defect: “From this side” is an unnatural Korean-syntax calque that obscures Taekyung’s resolve to stop passively enduring the attacks.
findings.rationale: 이쪽에서도 당하고 있을 수만은 없지 expresses that Taekyung cannot remain passive and continue being victimized.
findings.replacement: *I can’t just sit back and take it.*

findings.current: Even if a whole crowd of martial artists came instead of five or six minors, they would not be able to force their way in.
findings.defect: “Martial artists” inaccurately suggests Murim-style practitioners rather than modern combat-sports fighters.
findings.rationale: 격투기 선수 refers to combat-sports fighters; distinguishing them from martial artists is especially important in this series.
findings.replacement: Even if a whole crowd of professional fighters came instead of five or six minors, they would not be able to force their way in.
findings.source: 미성년자 대여섯이 아니라 격투기 선수가 떼거지로 와도 뚫을 수 없다.

findings.current:
“It’s fine. I’m looking for weapons for lower-grade Hunters.”

I pretended not to notice her expression darkening and stepped onto the escalator first.
findings.defect: “Lower-grade Hunters” conflicts with the required terminology reserving rank for Hunter classifications.
findings.rationale: 하급 modifies the Hunters’ classification, which should be expressed as rank rather than Grade.
findings.replacement:
“It’s fine. I’m looking for weapons for low-rank Hunters.”

I pretended not to notice her expression darkening and stepped onto the escalator first.
findings.source:
“괜찮아요. 제가 사려는 건 하급 헌터용 무기니까.”

살짝 어두워지는 직원의 얼굴을 모른 척하고 먼저 에스컬레이터에 올랐다.

findings.current:
“It’s fine. I’m looking for weapons for lower-grade Hunters.”

Assistant Manager Kim Seonhee secretly sighed at the customer’s words.
findings.defect: The repeated line again uses “grade” for a Hunter classification instead of the required “rank.”
findings.rationale: The intentionally repeated dialogue must retain identical wording while using the established Hunter-rank terminology.
findings.replacement:
“It’s fine. I’m looking for weapons for low-rank Hunters.”

Assistant Manager Kim Seonhee secretly sighed at the customer’s words.
findings.source:
“괜찮아요. 제가 사려는 건 하급 헌터용 무기니까.”

고객의 말에 김선희 대리는 몰래 한숨을 내쉬었다.

summary: One critical quantity error disrupts the final joke’s setup; additional findings concern the unidentified mage’s agency, access hierarchy, omitted concealment, register, terminology, and localized English.
